statements.status_notes: mathjax 2.7.9 is bundled inside nbclassic's static client-side assets at /opt/conda/lib/python3.13/site-packages/nbclassic/static/components/MathJax/. nbclassic is a compatibility shim for the legacy Jupyter Notebook UI; the default user-facing UI in this image is JupyterLab 4.x which uses its own (newer) MathJax bundle, not the bundled-with-nbclassic copy. The vulnerable ReDoS regex runs in the user's browser only if the user opts into the classic UI under /tree, and only with input the user themselves controls (math expressions in their own notebook). Upstream Mathjax 2.x is in long-term maintenance and no fix is planned in that line.
